import sys

def generate_graph(k):
    if k == 1:
        return 2, ["NY", "YN"]
    
    n = 2 + k - 1
    graph = [["N"] * n for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Connect vertex 1 to all vertices from 2 to k+1
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        graph[0][i] = "Y"
        graph[i][0] = "Y"
    
    # Connect vertex 2 to all vertices from k+2 to n
    for i in range(k + 1, n):
        graph[1][i] = "Y"
        graph[i][1] = "Y"
    
    # Connect all vertices from k+2 to n
    for i in range(k + 1, n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            graph[i][j] = "Y"
            graph[j][i] = "Y"
    
    return n, graph

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    k = int(data[0])
    
    n, graph = generate_graph(k)
    print(n)

        print("".join(row))
